        set dst 10.0.0.0 255.0.0.0
        set device "to-hq"
    next
    edit 2
        set dst 172.16.0.0 255.255.255.0
        set device "to-hq"
    next
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "lan-to-hq"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "to-hq"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set service "ALL"
        set schedule "always"
        set action accept
    next
    edit 2
        set name "hq-to-lan"
        set srcintf "to-hq"
        set dstintf "port1"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set service "ALL"
        set schedule "always"
        set action accept
    next
    edit 3
        set name "lan-to-internet"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set service "ALL"
        set schedule "always"
        set action accept
        set nat enable
    next
end
config system admin
    edit "admin"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
    next
end
